reaction.why: The only Cleric with native Counterspell, which Lone Wolf's spare reaction pays for; Spell Breaker hands the partner a save bonus.

durability.split: Monk 14 (Way of the Ascendant Dragon) / Cleric 6 (Twilight)
durability.why: The only Way whose aura covers the partner; Twilight Sanctuary stacks a per-round temp-HP aura on the same Wisdom stat.

front-line.split: Monk 14 (Way of the Astral Self) / Cleric 6 (Zeal)
front-line.why: Wisdom drives attack, damage, AC and DCs at once, dealing force damage; Zeal adds a Wisdom-scaled bonus-action attack.

front-line.split: Monk 17 (Way of the Kensei) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
front-line.why: Turns Monk into a weapon character, which matters because Listo's weapon pool is enormous; Agile Parry is near-free AC every turn.

monk/Way of the Kensei.uncertain: Sharpen the Blade does nothing on an already-enchanted weapon, so its value falls as loot arrives - size of that loss unquantified.

durability.split: Monk 17 (Way of the Long Death) / Cleric 3 (Grave)
durability.why: Mastery of Death converts going down into one ki, repeatably, from a short-rest pool - the failure mode that ends duo fights.
From 11 every Flurry strike is a free full heal, and Peace 1 puts a permanent d4 on both characters.

action-economy.split: Monk 17 (Way of the Sun Soul) / Rogue 3 (Thief)
action-economy.why: The only ranged Monk, and a second bonus action doubles the ki-bought bolt volleys; Searing Sunburst only reaches par AoE.

reaction.split: Monk 16 (Warrior of the Elements) / Fighter 2 (none) / Barbarian 2 (none)
reaction.why: Push and pull ride opportunity attacks with no save and no concentration, so both reactions become control on the enemy's turn.

monk/Warrior of the Elements (PHB2024 re.uncertain: Elemental Burst, Stride of the Elements and Elemental Epitome numbers are deferred to in-game screenshots and unverified.

durability.why: Per-turn temp HP on both characters with no action, Friar's Faith resistance as prevention, Cleansing Wave and Revivify as restoration.

durability.split: Mesmerist 14 (Aspect of the Trickster) / Paladin 6 (Oath of Devotion)
durability.why: Tricks fire as free actions on the partner: guaranteed miss, Greater Restoration, and Gift of Will stacking on Aura of Protection.

lockdown.split: Mesmerist 14 (Aspect of the Eyebiter) / Sorcerer 6 (Draconic Bloodline)
lockdown.why: Bold Stares are at-will, slot-free and concentration-free single-target lockdown; Psychic Inception at 7 closes the immunity hole.

mesmerist/Aspect of the Eyebiter — the d.uncertain: Mesmerist's maximum spell level is never stated by the mod; 5th is inferred from the half-caster table.

reaction.split: Mesmerist 17 (Aspect of the Daredevil) / Fighter 3 (Battle Master)
reaction.why: Superior Defense adds Charisma to AC and Parry subtracts 1d20+Dex+Cha; the extra reaction at 9 auto-Feints everyone who misses.

mesmerist/Aspect of the Daredevil — the.uncertain: Panache only refreshes on crits or kills with a one-handed piercing weapon, otherwise long rest - the Extra Attack gate may go dark mid-day.
